pages.text: $(italic)Melee/magic hybrid. Combines physical toughness with magical utility. Neither pure caster nor pure fighter.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: +5%  |  Equipment HP: Full$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() Swords (bonus), no ranged penalty

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Strikes$() — +10% attack damage baseline. Melee hits are magically enhanced.$(br2)$(bold)Spell Armor$() — +2 bonus armor from arcane wards. Stacks with worn armor for surprisingly high defense for a hybrid class.$(br2)$(bold)Mana Shield$() — Chance to negate incoming hits by consuming mana. Melee kills restore mana. Creates a fight-to-fuel-defense loop.

pages.title: Hybrid Playstyle
pages.text: The $(thing)Battlemage$() is the most durable caster class. Unlike the $(thing)Archmage$() who sacrifices everything for spell damage, the $(thing)Battlemage$() can stand in melee and survive.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Faefolk$() — Nature magic bonuses synergize with Botania and Ars Nouveau.$(br)$(thing)Orc$() — Attack speed + arcane strikes = fast magic-infused melee.$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$() — Extra armor effectiveness stacks with Spell Armor for extreme toughness.
